title: Binance NFT Upgrade to Binance Wallet and Limited Time Withdrawal Fee Reimbursement
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, To provide a more seamless and integrated NFT experience, we are upgrading the Binance NFT service to be made available on Binance Wallet, where users can manage their NFTs with easier access to Web3 and decentralized features. Starting  2026-06-03 , users holding transferable NFTs on Binance will have  one month  to withdraw their NFTs to their Binance Wallet or any other compatible wallets of their choice to continue managing their digital assets. Once the upgrade is complete on  2026-07-03 , users will no longer access support for the current NFT service on Binance Exchange and any NFTs not withdrawn by then will  no longer  be accessible. During this withdrawal period, we will proactively reach out to and remind transferable NFT holders to ensure a smooth process. Non-transferrable NFTs were coded to be non-transferrable from the onset and cannot be withdrawn. These non-transferrable NFTs will  no longer be accessible after 2026-07-03 . Binance Academy will issue PDF certificates to holders of non-transferrable NFTs that certified completion of Binance Academy courses.  NFT Withdrawal Fee Reimbursement Promotion Binance is offering two NFT withdrawal fee reimbursement promotions during this upgrade: General NFT Withdrawal Fee Reimbursement Promotion for non-CR7 NFTs CR7 NFT Withdrawal Reimbursement General NFT Withdrawal Fee Reimbursement Promotion A total of  up to 100,000 users  will be selected to receive reimbursements. Each selected user  will receive 1 USDC for an eligible NFT withdrawal . 1 USDC is the estimated cost to cover at least one NFT withdrawal transaction on the BSC or Ethereum networks. The reimbursement will be credited to eligible users’ Binance Spot Accounts by  2026-07-03 . To qualify, users must: Withdraw  non-CR7 NFTs  directly from the Binance NFT platform to  Binance Wallet (Keyless) ; Complete the withdrawal between  2026-06-03 00:00 (UTC)  and  2026-06-17 23:59 (UTC) ; Use the  BNB Smart Chain (BSC)  or  Ethereum  network; and Have held the NFT(s) on the Binance NFT platform before  2026-06-03 00:00 (UTC) . The  Prize Promotion Terms  apply.  CR7 NFT Withdrawal Fee Reimbursement Users who withdraw CR7 NFTs from the Binance NFT platform by  2026-07-03 23:59 (UTC)  are eligible to receive reimbursement. The withdrawal fees will be credited to eligible users’ Binance Spot Accounts by  2026-07-19 . To qualify, users must: Withdraw  CR7 NFTs directly  from the Binance NFT platform to any supported wallets; Complete the withdrawal on BNB Smart Chain between  2026-06-03 00:00 (UTC)  and  2026-07-03 23:59 (UTC) ; Have held the NFT(s) on the Binance NFT platform before  2026-06-03 00:00 (UTC) . Please Note:   Only successful withdrawal transactions will qualify for reimbursement. Binance reserves the right to disqualify any user from reimbursement eligibility due to fraudulent or abusive behavior. For more details, please refer to this  FAQ . There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support!
